entities.summary: Blake Coleman, nicknamed "Pickles", is an American professional ice hockey player who is a forward and alternate captain for the Calgary Flames of the National Hockey League (NHL). He was selected in the third round, 75th overall, by the New Jersey Devils during the 2011 NHL Entry Draft and spent five seasons with them before being traded to the Tampa Bay Lightning. Coleman won back-to-back Stanley Cup championships with the Lightning in 2020 and 2021, becoming the second Texas-born player to win the Stanley Cup and first to be exclusively trained in the state.
